name: dbt-anvil
description: A VS Code extension that gives dbt the same kind of language support that most programming languages have had for years. Now it's here, for dbt Core.

Always start the MCP server and register tools, even if Claude Code is not detected.

dbt-anvil.mcp.registration.markdownDescription: Controls whether dbt Anvil runs its MCP subsystem for Claude Code. In `auto` mode the extension only starts the local MCP server and writes config files when Claude Code is installed; otherwise the subsystem stays dormant.

dbt-anvil.profilesDir.description: Path to dbt profiles directory. Leave empty to use project directory or ~/.dbt.

dbt-anvil.logLevel.description: Log level for dbt Anvil output channel.

enumDescriptions: Parse SQL with the native TypeScript sqllens engine (default). No Pyodide worker pool is booted — faster activation, lower memory.
Parse SQL with the Pyodide/sqlglot engine (WASM CPython). Boots a worker pool on activation; the fallback engine, kept until it is removed.
dbt-anvil.parser.engine.markdownDescription: Selects the SQL parsing engine that powers language intelligence (hover, definition, rename, diagnostics, formatting, lineage). `sqllens` (default) uses the native TypeScript parser and skips booting Pyodide; `legacy` uses the Pyodide/sqlglot worker pool. A window reload is required for a change to take effect.

dbt-anvil.layers.markdownDescription:
Ordered list of **data layers** for your project (e.g. `raw → bronze → silver → gold → marts`). Order defines ordinality — index 0 is the upstream-most layer. Layers are a dbt Anvil-local concept used for classification, grouping, and architectural rules; they are never written to `manifest.json` or passed to the dbt CLI.

Each entry has a `name` and a `match` rule. First match wins, top-down. Models matching no layer remain unclassified.

**Scope**: only dbt **models** (plus seeds, snapshots, analyses) are classified. `source:` definitions from `schema.yml` are _not_ matched — they sit conceptually upstream of every layer. If you want sources to show up as `raw`, classify the staging models that wrap them (e.g. by tag or folder) instead of adding a `sources` layer.

Example:
```json
[
  { "name": "raw",     "match": { "folder": "models/raw" } },
  { "name": "bronze",  "match": { "tag": "bronze" } },
  { "name": "silver",  "match": { "namePrefix": "slv_" } },
  { "name": "gold",    "match": { "any": [ { "folder": "models/gold" }, { "tag": "gold" } ] } },
  { "name": "marts",   "match": { "folder": "models/marts" } }
]
```

match.description: Match rule. Leaf fields (folder, namePrefix, nameRegex, tag, materialization) are ANDed together. Use `any` for OR, or `all` for explicit AND over nested matchers.

folder.description: Folder prefix relative to the project directory (e.g. "models/gold"). Matches if the model file path starts with this segment.

nameRegex.description: Regex tested against the model name. Anchor with ^/$ if needed.

folder.description: Folder prefix relative to the project directory.

dbt-anvil.lineage.showTests.description: Show test nodes in the lineage graph.

dbt-anvil.providers.codeLens.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show Run / Build / Test / Compile code lens actions above dbt SQL models and test entries in schema.yml.

dbt-anvil.providers.documentSymbols.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Populate the Outline panel and breadcrumbs with CTEs (SQL files) and model/column hierarchy (YAML files).

dbt-anvil.providers.workspaceSymbols.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Include dbt models, sources, and macros in workspace symbol search (Ctrl+T / Cmd+T).

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.hover.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show hover tooltips for `ref()`, `source()`, macros, CTE names, and column names in Jinja SQL files.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.completion.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Provide autocomplete for `ref()`, `source()`, macros, columns, and table names after FROM/JOIN in Jinja SQL files.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.definition.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Enable Go to Definition for `ref()`, `source()`, macros, CTEs, and column names in Jinja SQL files.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.references.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Enable Find All References for `ref()`, `source()`, and column names in Jinja SQL files.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.rename.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Enable Rename Symbol for dbt models — updates `ref()` calls, schema.yml entries, and renames the `.sql` file. Works best when `sql.definition` is also enabled.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.signatureHelp.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show parameter hints when typing dbt macro calls in Jinja SQL files.

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.codeActions.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show quick-fix actions for unknown `ref()` and `source()` calls in Jinja SQL files (e.g. create missing model file).

dbt-anvil.providers.sql.diagnostics.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show dbt parse errors, unknown `ref()`/`source()` calls, and invalid column names in the Problems panel. Disabling this clears all dbt Anvil diagnostics immediately.

dbt-anvil.providers.yaml.hover.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Show hover tooltips for model and source names in dbt schema YAML files.

dbt-anvil.providers.yaml.completion.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Provide autocomplete for model names, column names, tags, test names, and source references in dbt schema YAML files.

dbt-anvil.notifications.suppressSqlFluff.markdownDescription: Suppress the notice about SQLFluff being active alongside dbt Anvil.

dbt-anvil.notifications.suppressAutoSave.markdownDescription: Suppress the warning about auto-save triggering frequent dbt parse runs.

dbt-anvil.notifications.suppressFormatte.markdownDescription: Suppress the warning about dbt Anvil not being set as the default formatter for SQL files.

dbt-anvil.terminal.externalCommandMonito.markdownDescription: **⚠️ Disabling this is strongly discouraged.** dbt Anvil monitors terminal shell executions and automatically suspends its own background operations when you run `dbt run`, `build`, `seed`, `snapshot`, `clone`, or `run-operation` directly in a terminal. Without this, concurrent dbt writes can corrupt the manifest and produce stale intellisense, phantom errors, and incorrect lineage. Only disable if VS Code shell integration is causing unrelated problems in your environment.

dbt-anvil.terminal.contributeCliShim.markdownDescription: Contribute a `dbt` command to integrated terminals that delegates to the detected package manager (uv, poetry, etc.). When enabled, you can type `dbt build` in the terminal instead of `uv run dbt build`.

dbt-anvil.ninja.enabled.markdownDescription: Master switch for the Ninja subsystem. When off, **all** of these are disabled: diagnostics (Problems panel), Format Document, auto-fix on save, and code actions. To silence diagnostics only while keeping formatting and code actions, use `#dbt-anvil.ninja.diagnostics.enabled#` instead.

dbt-anvil.ninja.diagnostics.enabled.markdownDescription: Show Ninja violations in the Problems panel. Turn off to hide diagnostics while keeping **Format Document** and code actions working. Requires `#dbt-anvil.ninja.enabled#`.

dbt-anvil.ninja.disabledRules.markdownDescription: Rule IDs that are completely disabled — no diagnostic, no autofix. Use the rule editor UI to manage this list. To silence a rule while keeping its autofix, use `mute` in `#dbt-anvil.ninja.rules#` instead.

dbt-anvil.ninja.rules.markdownDescription: Per-rule severity overrides. Keys are Ninja rule IDs, values are `error`, `warning`, `info`, `hint`, or `mute`.

enumDescriptions: Show as error in Problems panel.
Show as warning in Problems panel.
Show as information in Problems panel.
Show as hint (subtle underline) in editor; not shown in Problems panel.
Apply autofix silently during formatting — no diagnostic shown anywhere.
sqlfmt style: 88-char lines, lowercase, trailing commas.
dbt Labs style guide: 120-char lines, lowercase, leading commas.
dbt Anvil house style: leading commas + operators, plus forced multi-line wrapping for GROUP BY, ORDER BY, OVER window, CASE, and WHERE/HAVING boolean chains.
No preset — all settings use their explicit values or defaults.
dbt-anvil.ninja.format.preset.markdownDescription: Named style preset. Provides defaults for unset config keys; explicit overrides always win. **New installs** default to `sqlfmt`; existing users whose settings are already configured see no change.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.select.markdownDescription: Always wrap multi-target SELECT lists onto multiple lines (one target per line), regardless of whether the collapsed form would fit within `#dbt-anvil.ninja.maxLineLength#`. Single-target SELECTs stay inline. Default `true` matches sqlfmt and dbt Labs conventions — set `false` to keep short multi-target SELECTs on one line.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.groupB.markdownDescription: Always wrap top-level GROUP BY clauses with 2+ targets onto multiple lines (one target per line), regardless of width. Single-target `group by x` stays inline.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.orderB.markdownDescription: Always wrap top-level ORDER BY clauses with 2+ targets onto multiple lines (one target per line), regardless of width. Single-target `order by x` stays inline.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.window.markdownDescription: Always put `PARTITION BY` inside an `OVER(...)` window on its own line with 2+ targets each on their own line, regardless of width. The OVER paren opens an indented block.
Always put `ORDER BY` inside an `OVER(...)` window on its own line with 2+ targets each on their own line, regardless of width.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.case.markdownDescription: Always wrap `CASE` expressions with 2+ WHEN branches across multiple lines (one branch per line), regardless of width. Single-branch CASE stays inline.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.where.markdownDescription: Always put `WHERE` on its own line and indent every predicate (including the first) onto its own line, when the WHERE has 2+ predicates joined by `AND`/`OR`. Single-predicate WHEREs stay inline (`where x = 1`).

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.alwaysWrap.having.markdownDescription: Always put `HAVING` on its own line and indent every predicate (including the first) onto its own line, when the HAVING has 2+ predicates joined by `AND`/`OR`. Single-predicate HAVINGs stay inline.

dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.applyOnFormat.markdownDescription: Apply safe auto-fixes when **Format Document** (`Shift+Alt+F`) is invoked on a SQL file. Which rules auto-fix is controlled by `#dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.rules#`.

dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.applyOnFixAll.markdownDescription: Enable auto-fix on save. Which rules auto-fix is controlled by `#dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.rules#`.

dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.rules.markdownDescription: Per-rule auto-fix overrides. Only applies when `#dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.applyOnFormat#` or `#dbt-anvil.ninja.autoFix.applyOnFixAll#` is enabled.

dbt-anvil.ninja.capitalisation.keywords.markdownDescription: Capitalisation policy for SQL keywords (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, etc.).

dbt-anvil.ninja.capitalisation.functions.markdownDescription: Capitalisation policy for SQL function names (count, coalesce, etc.).

dbt-anvil.ninja.capitalisation.literals.markdownDescription: Capitalisation policy for SQL literals (NULL, TRUE, FALSE).

dbt-anvil.ninja.capitalisation.types.markdownDescription: Capitalisation policy for SQL datatype keywords (INT, VARCHAR, BOOLEAN, etc.).

dbt-anvil.ninja.capitalisation.identifie.markdownDescription: Identifier style policy for introduced identifiers (column aliases, CTE names, table aliases). `off` disables the check. Violations are surfaced as diagnostics with a per-site rename code action — never auto-fixed.

Acronyms allowed as a single uppercase run inside camelCase/PascalCase identifiers (e.g. `MyURL` instead of `MyUrl`). Matched case-insensitively. Used both to forgive acronym runs during detection and to preserve them when proposing renames.

Optional whole-word tokens used to segment all-lowercase identifiers that lack visible markers (e.g. `customerid` → `customer_id` when `id` is in the list). Detection-only — without entries here, all-lowercase identifiers are accepted as valid single-word names (same as IntelliJ/VS behaviour).

dbt-anvil.ninja.indentation.size.markdownDescription: Number of spaces (or tabs) per indent level.

dbt-anvil.ninja.indentation.indentedJoin.markdownDescription: Indent JOIN clauses one extra level relative to FROM (sqlfluff: `indented_joins`).

dbt-anvil.ninja.indentation.indentedOn.markdownDescription: Indent ON/USING one level under their JOIN clause (sqlfluff: `indented_using_on`).

dbt-anvil.ninja.indentation.indentedThen.markdownDescription: Indent THEN one level under its WHEN clause (sqlfluff: `indented_then`).

dbt-anvil.ninja.indentation.indentedCtes.markdownDescription: Indent CTE body one extra level (sqlfluff: `indented_ctes`).

dbt-anvil.ninja.maxLineLength.markdownDescription: Maximum line length before the long-lines rule triggers.

dbt-anvil.ninja.maxBlankLines.markdownDescription: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines allowed.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.commaPosition.markdownDescription: Whether commas should appear at end (trailing) or start (leading) of lines.

dbt-anvil.ninja.layout.operatorPosition.markdownDescription: Whether operators (AND, OR, +, etc.) should appear at end (trailing) or start (leading) of lines.

dbt-anvil.ninja.structure.allowStarInCte.markdownDescription: Allow `SELECT *` inside CTEs (only flag it in the final SELECT).

dbt-anvil.ninja.convention.unionStyle.markdownDescription: Whether bare `UNION` should be auto-fixed to `UNION ALL` or `UNION DISTINCT`.

dbt-anvil.ninja.convention.explicitAs.markdownDescription: Require the `AS` keyword for table aliases, e.g. `FROM orders AS o` rather than `FROM orders o`. Controls the `ninja.aliasing.table-as` rule.

dbt-anvil.ninja.convention.explicitInner.markdownDescription: Require `INNER JOIN` instead of bare `JOIN`. Controls the `ninja.convention.explicit-inner-join` rule.

dbt-anvil.ninja.workspaceDiagnostics.markdownDescription: Run Ninja linting on all SQL files in the workspace (not just open files). Results appear in the Problems panel and a status bar item shows the total issue count.

dbt-anvil.database.preferNativeAdapter.markdownDescription: **Enabled**: Use a native database adapter (e.g. Databricks REST API) for faster parallel queries when available. Disable to force all queries through `dbt show` instead — useful as a fallback if the native adapter has issues.

dbt-anvil.queryEditor.defaultLimit.markdownDescription: Default row limit for ad-hoc query execution. Override per-statement with an explicit `LIMIT` clause in SQL.

dbt-anvil.queryEditor.stopOnError.markdownDescription: Stop executing remaining statements when one fails. When disabled, errors are shown per-statement and execution continues.

enumDescriptions: Keep results wherever they already are (editor tab or panel).
Always show results in an editor tab, split below the active file.
Always show results in the bottom Query Results panel.
dbt-anvil.queryEditor.resultLocation.markdownDescription: Where query results appear after each execution.

languageModelTools.name: run_models
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run dbt models using node selection syntax
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run dbt models using node selection syntax (--select). Supports model names, tags, paths, and wildcards. Use select_state_modified to run only changed models since last run.

select.description: Node selection expression (e.g., 'my_model', 'tag:marketing', 'path/to/models'). Optional when using state selection or confirm_all_resources.

full_refresh.description: Run with --full-refresh flag for incremental models

cache_selected_only.description: Only cache selected models (default: true when select is provided)

select_state_modified.description: Select only models modified since last run (state:modified)

select_state_modified_plus_downstream.description: When select_state_modified is true, also include downstream of modified models (state:modified+)

confirm_all_resources.description: Explicit opt-in to run EVERY model in the project. REQUIRED when neither `select` nor `select_state_modified` is provided — the tool will reject the call otherwise. Set to true only when the user has clearly asked to run the entire project.

languageModelTools.name: test_models
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run dbt tests using node selection syntax
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run dbt tests using node selection syntax. Use fail_fast to stop on first failure. Use keep_cte_tests to generate CTE test models before running tests.

select_state_modified.description: Select only models modified since last run

select_state_modified_plus_downstream.description: Also include downstream of modified models

keep_cte_tests.description: Generate CTE test models before running tests

languageModelTools.name: build_models
languageModelTools.userDescription: Build dbt models (run + test) using node selection syntax
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run dbt build (run + test) using node selection syntax. Supports resource type filtering, state-based selection, and fail fast.

cache_selected_only.description: Only cache selected models (default: true when select is provided)

select_state_modified.description: Select only models modified since last run

select_state_modified_plus_downstream.description: Also include downstream of modified models

languageModelTools.name: compile_model
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compile a dbt model to see generated SQL without executing it
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compile a dbt model to see the generated SQL without executing it.

languageModelTools.name: get_lineage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get upstream and downstream lineage for a dbt resource
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get upstream and downstream lineage for any dbt resource (model, source, seed, etc.). Specify direction to get only upstream or downstream. Works with models and sources.

name.description: Resource name to get lineage for

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type (model, source, seed, snapshot)

depth.description: How many levels of lineage to traverse (omit for unlimited)

languageModelTools.name: get_column_lineage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Trace column-level lineage through SQL transformations showing upstream/downstream dependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Trace column-level lineage through SQL transformations. Uses sqlglot to parse compiled SQL and track how columns flow through CTEs, JOINs, aggregations, and transformations. Requires a specific column name.

column.description: Column name to trace lineage for

languageModelTools.name: list_resources
languageModelTools.userDescription: List dbt project resources with optional filtering by type
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List dbt project resources (models, tests, sources, snapshots, seeds) with optional filtering.

languageModelTools.name: get_resource_info
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get detailed information about a dbt resource including columns, compiled SQL, and tests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get detailed information about a dbt resource (model, source, test, etc.) including columns, the fully-qualified relation_name (e.g. "db"."schema"."table" — use this in query_database for plain SQL, avoiding an inline compile), database, schema, alias, raw SQL, and description. Compiled SQL is NOT included by default — set include_compiled_sql=true only when you need the rendered SQL body (triggers a dbt compile, which runs serialized through the dbt bridge).

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type (model, source, seed, etc.)

include_compiled_sql.description: Include compiled SQL in output, triggering a dbt compile if not already cached (default: false). Leave false when you only need the relation_name/schema/columns — those are returned for free from the manifest.

languageModelTools.name: get_project_info
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get dbt project overview including name, adapter, model count, and connection status
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get dbt project overview including model count, dbt version, and optionally run dbt debug to check connection status.

run_debug.description: Run dbt debug to check connection status (default: true)

languageModelTools.name: query_database
languageModelTools.userDescription: Execute a SQL query against the configured database using dbt show
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute a SQL query against the configured database. PREFER plain SQL with fully-qualified identifiers (e.g. SELECT * FROM "analytics"."marts"."dim_customers" LIMIT 10) — look up each model/source's relation_name via get_resource_info or list_resources first. Plain SQL goes directly to the native database connection and multiple queries run IN PARALLEL. Jinja ({{ ref('x') }}, {{ source('s','t') }}) is supported but triggers an inline dbt compile that runs SERIALIZED through the dbt bridge — slower, and it blocks every other dbt operation (other queries, compiles, parses) while it runs. Include LIMIT in your SQL to control row count. Use cte_name + model_name to extract and query a specific CTE from a model.

sql.description: SQL query to execute. Prefer plain SQL with fully-qualified identifiers from relation_name — these run in parallel on the native connection. Jinja ({{ ref() }}, {{ source() }}) is supported but slower and serialized. Include LIMIT to control row count.

cte_name.description: Name of a CTE to extract from the model (requires model_name)

model_name.description: Model that contains the CTE to extract (requires cte_name)

languageModelTools.name: install_deps
languageModelTools.userDescription: Install dbt project package dependencies (dbt deps)

languageModelTools.name: analyze_impact
languageModelTools.userDescription: Analyze which downstream models will be affected by changes to a resource
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze the impact of changes to a dbt resource — which downstream models, seeds, and snapshots will be affected. Works with any resource type.

name.description: Resource name to analyze impact for

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type (model, source, seed, etc.)

languageModelTools.name: load_seeds
languageModelTools.userDescription: Load dbt seed CSV files into the database
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Load seed data files into the database (dbt seed). Use show to display loaded data. Supports state-based selection.

select.description: Seed selection. Required unless select_state_modified or confirm_all_resources is set.

select_state_modified.description: Select only seeds modified since last run

select_state_modified_plus_downstream.description: Also include downstream of modified seeds

confirm_all_resources.description: Explicit opt-in to load EVERY seed in the project (with full_refresh this drops + recreates all seed tables). REQUIRED when neither `select` nor `select_state_modified` is provided — the tool will reject the call otherwise. Set to true only when the user has clearly asked to load all seeds.

languageModelTools.name: snapshot_models
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run dbt snapshot to capture point-in-time records
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run dbt snapshot to capture slowly changing dimension records. Supports optional node selection and exclusion.

select.description: Snapshot selection. Required unless confirm_all_resources is set.

confirm_all_resources.description: Explicit opt-in to run EVERY snapshot in the project. REQUIRED when `select` is not provided — the tool will reject the call otherwise. Set to true only when the user has clearly asked to snapshot everything.

languageModelTools.name: get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read errors and warnings from the VS Code Problems panel
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return diagnostics from the VS Code Problems panel. Sources include TypeScript, ESLint, the dbt-anvil Ninja linter, and any other active linter. Use to verify edits before declaring work done. Pass 'path' to scope to one file. Positions are 1-indexed.

path.description: Optional file path (absolute, workspace-relative, or URI). If omitted, returns all workspace diagnostics.

max_results.description: Maximum number of diagnostics to return (default 200)

languageModelTools.name: workspace_symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Semantic symbol search across the workspace using the language server
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find symbols (classes, functions, methods, variables) by name across the workspace using the language server. More accurate than text search because it uses type information. Returns up to max_results matches with file, line, and kind.

query.description: Symbol name or partial name to search for

max_results.description: Maximum number of symbols to return (default 100)

languageModelTools.name: navigate_symbol
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the definition, references, implementations, or type definition for a symbol at a position
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Given a file and a 1-indexed position, resolve one of: 'definition', 'references', 'implementations', 'type_definition', 'declaration'. Uses the language server, so it is semantically accurate. Better than grep for renames, method calls, interface implementations.

kind.description: Which kind of navigation to perform

max_results.description: Maximum number of locations to return (default 200)

languageModelToolSets.name: project
languageModelToolSets.description: Get project overview, list and inspect dbt resources — models, sources, seeds, snapshots, and tests with full metadata and compiled SQL

languageModelToolSets.name: lineage
languageModelToolSets.description: Trace dependencies, analyze change impact, and inspect column-level lineage across all resource types

languageModelToolSets.description: Execute SQL queries against your database using dbt show — supports Jinja templating and CTE extraction

languageModelToolSets.description: Run, test, build, seed, snapshot and compile dbt models — with state-based selection, fail-fast, and full-refresh support
